title: a trusted entry is compared by real path: a symlink and a path with .. both resolve to the folder they lead to
source: intended: builds come from layers (repo, trusted parent folders, user folder), nearest wins (docs/decisions.md)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-12, build layers). Each trusted_parents entry is expanded (~/ is HOME), cleaned (a/b/.. is a) and resolved through symlinks before it is compared with the project's real path. The three spellings below all lead to the outer fixture project, so its builds are a parent layer of the nested checkout, listed under the real path.
